title: Device overlay
description: What Danbyte adds to one upstream NetBox device type, in `danbyte/overlays/<Vendor>/<model>.yaml`. It names its upstream file and adds or patches only what Danbyte needs: Danbyte keys (`model3d`, `rack_mount`, `meta`), NetBox top-level keys that need correcting, and component lists patched by name with `add:` / `remove:` entries that each say `why`. The merge (`danbyte-lib preview`) is what Danbyte imports; upstream fixes flow in untouched, and `sync-check` reports patched names that upstream no longer has.

upstream.description: The NetBox YAML this overlay adds to, relative to the repository root: an upstream file under `device-types/`, or a Danbyte-only base under `danbyte/types-new/device-types/` for hardware upstream doesn't have yet. Never edited by the overlay.

part_number.description: NetBox key, overriding upstream: The vendor part number, when upstream's is wrong.

u_height.description: NetBox key, overriding upstream: Height in rack units.

is_full_depth.description: NetBox key, overriding upstream: Whether it occupies the rack's full depth.

airflow.description: NetBox key, overriding upstream: NetBox airflow slug (front-to-rear, rear-to-front, …).

weight.description: NetBox key, overriding upstream: Weight, in weight_unit.

weight_unit.description: NetBox key, overriding upstream: Unit of weight.

front_image.description: NetBox key, overriding upstream: Whether a front elevation image exists.

rear_image.description: NetBox key, overriding upstream: Whether a rear elevation image exists.

subdevice_role.description: NetBox key, overriding upstream: NetBox subdevice role.

is_powered.description: NetBox key, overriding upstream: Whether the type draws power.

description.description: NetBox key, overriding upstream: Short description.

comments.description: NetBox key, overriding upstream: Free text (Markdown).

drop.description: Upstream top-level keys this overlay removes, each with why (for example `subdevice_role` on a unit Danbyte models alone). Component lists are never dropped; patch them with `remove:`.

width_mm.description: The unit's own width in mm, for a unit narrower than the 19-inch frame (half-width, compact, desktop); Danbyte frames its photos and places it on a shelf by it.

height_mm.description: The unit's own height in mm, when it is not a whole number of rack units.

depth_mm.description: The unit's own depth in mm.

rack_width.description: `half` for a half-width unit (at most 241 mm wide); left out for a full-width one.
